2024 Topps Stadium Club — Red Foil Parallel Lot (3 Cards)
Shota Imanaga #240 — Rookie Card, Chicago Cubs
Bob Gibson #202 — St. Louis Cardinals, Cooperstown Collection
J.P. Crawford #289 — Seattle Mariners
